tasks.subject: Scope 1: Scaffold + Schema + Ledger
tasks.description: Create ai-credits repo scaffold (go.mod go 1.26 module github.com/calionauta/ai-credits, LICENSE MIT, AGENTS.md, .golangci.yml, CI.yml, README stub), schema.sql + EnsureSchema (credit_accounts, credit_transactions, credit_reservations, llm_usage, byok_credentials with INTEGER timestamps), credits.go (Config/New), types.go (errors/Usage/Result), ledger.go (Grant/Refund/Balance single-tx idempotent). Per spec-tech scope 1 and PLAN §3, §4, §9, Stage 0-1. Must green: go build, go test -race, golangci-lint.

tasks.subject: Scope 2: Pricing + Usage
tasks.description: pricing.go (Engine: Load defaults/JSON, Cost, EstimateMax, Credits, microunits_per_credit=$0.001), usage.go (RecordUsage → llm_usage). Per PLAN §5. Implements ErrUnknownModel, EstimateMax>=Cost invariant, pricing_version. Tests per PLAN Stage 2.

tasks.subject: Scope 3: Reservations
tasks.description: reservation.go Reserve/Settle/Release per PLAN §6.1-6.3. Settle caps at reserved; usage>reserved → ErrReservationClosed. Concurrency-safe anti-negative guard, idempotent by requestID. Tests: 500/137/363, 100-goroutine -race (20 ok/80 ErrInsufficientCredits), duplicate, closed state. Per spec-tech scope 3.

tasks.subject: Scope 4: Monthly + Reconcile
tasks.description: monthly.go EnsureMonthlyGrant (lazy idempotent, key monthly:user:period), reconcile.go Reconcile (orphan expiry + balance vs ledger mismatch report, no auto-fix). Clock injection cfg.Now. Tests per PLAN §6.5-6.6, Stage 4.

tasks.subject: Scope 5: BYOK (credentials + relay)
tasks.description: byok/credentials.go CredentialStore (XChaCha20-Poly1305, 32B key, 24B nonce), byok/relay.go Relay (httputil.ReverseProxy pass-through with Bearer key injection, X-Byok strip, 404 without credential). Tests per PLAN §7, Stage 5.

tasks.subject: Scope 6: gogogo plugin integration
tasks.description: Add lib as dependency to gogogo-fullstack-template; features/credits/ plugin (credits.go, gateway.go RunManaged, routes.go + router/credits.go, SCOPE-marked, env-gated); relay behind auth; credits_test.go with internal/llm/fakeserver. Per PLAN §11. Requires make ci-local green.

tasks.subject: Scope 7: treinamento integration
tasks.description: Add lib dependency to treinador-praticas-narrativas; thin features/credits/; chat_send.go wrapped with RunManaged/BYOK; /api/credits + relay behind auth; chat_gateway test with LLM stub. Per PLAN §12.

tasks.subject: Scope 8: Stripe top-up (apps)
tasks.description: Env-gated stripe.go checkout + webhook → Grant(key="stripe:"+payment_intent_id) in both apps. Webhook replay → single grant (idempotency UNIQUE). No STRIPE_SECRET_KEY → feature off. Per PLAN §8, Stage 8.
